scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "infra,backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run dev:infra" "npm run dev -w @othelio/backend" "npm run dev -w @othelio/fe"
scripts.dev:infra:reset: docker compose down --remove-orphans && docker compose up --build --force-recreate
scripts.build: npm run build -w @othelio/shared && npm run build -w @othelio/fe && npm run build -w @othelio/backend
